notes.subject: ol tausen genarosen
notes.rationale: לאלפים: JPS 'wan tausen genarosen' (olgeta i wantaim) o KJV 'ol tausen man' — namba em i mining bilong planti, i no namba street.

notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד i mining 'marimari, gutpela pasin, pasin stret long kontrak' — mi holim tok Hibru, i no tanim long 'marimari' tasol.

translation: Na em i wokim khesed long ol tausen genarosen, long ol man i lavim mi, na long ol man i ken holim ol toksave bilong en.

tokens.gloss: long ol man i lavim mi
na long ol man i ken holim
